title: Instruction gate encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $n,z,T,i$ be natural numbers or bit strings as appropriate: the instruction bit string is the gate encoding of the gates produced by tabulating the instruction selected by the configuration at index $i$, for input data $z$, parameters $n,T$, and machine $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
